trials.output_a: Rain pattered down. Mara trudged along. The street was as deserted as a ghost town on a Sunday. She approached the door and gave it a good, solid knock—two sharp taps. Silence greeted her. No one seemed home, not even a stray cat.
trials.output_b: The rain fell in long silver threads, and Mara strolled through it leisurely, as if the storm was holding its breath for her. When she finally got to the door and discovered it locked, she knocked—twice, gently, like a polite question she already knew might go unanswered.
